desc:
V2.01.2

!! GAMEPASS ITEMS REGARDING V2.0 !! 
Gamepass items won't spawn in your backpack with the new saved backpack system for the first time. You will have to get gamepass items from the SHOP (they're still free, of course) to have them spawn on your backpack again when you rejoin. These items will stay in your backpack for 7 days, then you can re-rent them for free once they expire.


💰 2X COINS ON FRIDAYS AND SATURDAYS!

Survive dangerous disasters ranging from natural to artificial hazards! Surviving will award you coins which are used to buy items that will help aid you. Survive more, earn more, get better gear, and even upgrade your gears!

Main composer: SkyTheFloof
